mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 5% for three consecutive months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 5% for two consecutive months signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 for three consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, which lowers real interest rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness, which raises real interest rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 for three consecutive months indicates contracting domestic demand, which raises real interest rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in demand contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 for two consecutive months indicates expanding domestic demand, which compresses discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in demand expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 244 for three consecutive months indicates disinflation, lowering real interest rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 244 for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary policy easing, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
